sloka: अंबरीषस्य पुत्रो अभूत् नहुषः च महीपतिः ।नहुषस्य ययातिः तु नाभागः तु ययाति जः ॥१-७०-४२॥
transliteration: aṁbarīṣasya putro abhūt nahuṣaḥ ca mahīpatiḥ ।nahuṣasya yayātiḥ tu nābhāgaḥ tu yayāti jaḥ ॥1-70-42॥

translations.english: King Nahusha was the son of Ambarisha. To Nahusha was born Yayati whose son was Nabhaga.
